newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon finalises Providian insurance deal.
newsitem.headline: Aegon finalises Providian insurance deal.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon said on Wednesday it had completed the acquisition of Providian's insurance operations.
It said in a statement the banking activities of Providian Corporation had been spun off as a separate company, Providian Financial Corporation.

"This acquisition significantly enhances AEGON USA's market position...It will add an immediate boost to the Group's earnings and earnings per share," Aegon Chairman Kees Storm was quoted as saying. The takeover, valued at $3.5 billion, is the largest ever by a Dutch company.
It is based on a tax-free share-swap and had been approved by Providian shareholders on June 9.
